mapper.select: SELECT id, rule_code AS ruleCode, rule_type AS ruleType, warn_level AS warnLevel, expression_json AS expressionJson, priority, status, item_type AS itemType FROM mon_rule WHERE status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 AND (item_type = 0 OR item_type = #{itemType}) ORDER BY priority DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mon_rule (rule_code, rule_name, hazard_type, item_type, stage, section_id, rule_type, warn_level, expression_json, priority, version, status, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{ruleCode}, #{ruleName}, #{hazardType}, #{itemType}, #{stage}, #{sectionId}, #{ruleType}, #{warnLevel}, #{expressionJson}, #{priority}, #{version}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, rule_code AS ruleCode, rule_name AS ruleName, hazard_type AS hazardType, item_type AS itemType, stage, section_id AS sectionId, rule_type AS ruleType, warn_level AS warnLevel, expression_json AS expressionJson, priority, version, status, remark FROM mon_rule WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT r.id, r.rule_code AS ruleCode, r.rule_name AS ruleName, r.hazard_type AS hazardType, r.item_type AS itemType, r.stage, r.section_id AS sectionId, r.rule_type AS ruleType, r.warn_level AS warnLevel, r.expression_json AS expressionJson, r.priority, r.version, r.status, r.remark FROM mon_rule r JOIN (SELECT rule_code, MAX(version) AS mv FROM mon_rule WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY rule_code) x ON r.rule_code = x.rule_code AND r.version = x.mv WHERE r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.hazard_type = #{hazardType} AND r.item_type = #{itemType} AND r.status = #{status} ORDER BY r.id

SELECT id, rule_code AS ruleCode, rule_name AS ruleName, hazard_type AS hazardType, item_type AS itemType, stage, section_id AS sectionId, rule_type AS ruleType, warn_level AS warnLevel, expression_json AS expressionJson, priority, version, status, remark FROM mon_rule WHERE rule_code = #{ruleCode} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warn_event WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mon_rule SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE rule_code = #{ruleCode} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE mon_rule SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
